headline: I've got nothing put away. Is my energy blocking my money?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. Nothing showed through the backs, but your hand went to the one who came equipped.
A cup, a coin, a blade and a wand are already spread across his table.
You said you have nothing put away and asked whether your energy blocks your money. The complete table catches my attention.
Still, nothing is put away, and the money remains blocked.
Whatever is blocking the result leaves every tool on the table. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding the money…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You chose without seeing him and found the card with room around the restraint.
One ankle is held by the rope. The rest of his body hangs loose.
You asked whether your energy is holding the money. This card makes me look at the space around that one rope.
And yet the money is held. Your question has turned toward your own energy.
Something reaches the money just where it would stay with you. I don't think it started with you.
Let me look closer at what that is…
c: You turned the Fool. The cards were face down, but you still chose the one carrying almost nothing.
The bundle on his stick is small enough to hold in one hand.
You asked whether your energy explains why nothing is put away. This card brings me to the small bundle.
But the money has not built behind you, and you are asking whether your energy is why.
Something sits between movement and what remains. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
